+"""REST and webhook connector kinds.
+
+Both kinds share one HTTP puller: a REST endpoint returns a JSON document, and a
+webhook connector posts a configured request (usually to a webhook inbox or a
+subscription endpoint) and normalizes the JSON response. The transport is
+injectable so tests never touch the network.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import urllib.request
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_connectors.models import (
+    HealthStatus,
+    IngestBatch,
+    IngestRecord,
+    RestConnectorSettings,
+)
+from agentic_odi_connectors.protocol import Connector
+
+FetchResult = tuple[int, bytes]
+Fetcher = Callable[[str, str, dict[str, str], bytes | None, float], FetchResult]
+
+
+def _default_fetch(
+    method: str,
+    url: str,
+    headers: dict[str, str],
+    body: bytes | None,
+    timeout: float,
+) -> FetchResult:
+    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method=method)
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:  # nosec B310
+        return int(response.status), response.read()
+
+
+def _lookup(payload: Any, path: str) -> Any:
+    current = payload
+    for part in path.split("."):
+        if not isinstance(current, dict) or part not in current:
+            return None
+        current = current[part]
+    return current
+
+
+class RestConnector(Connector):
+    """Pulls JSON records from an HTTP endpoint into the ingest sink."""
+
+    kind = "rest"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        settings: RestConnectorSettings,
+        *,
+        kind: str | None = None,
+        fetcher: Fetcher | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.name = name
+        self.settings = settings
+        self.kind = kind or type(self).kind
+        self._fetch = fetcher or _default_fetch
+
+    def _request(self) -> FetchResult:
+        body = None
+        headers = dict(self.settings.headers)
+        if self.settings.json_body is not None:
+            body = json.dumps(self.settings.json_body).encode("utf-8")
+            headers.setdefault("Content-Type", "application/json")
+        return self._fetch(
+            self.settings.method,
+            self.settings.url,
+            headers,
+            body,
+            self.settings.timeout,
+        )
+
+    def _items(self, payload: Any) -> list[Any]:
+        if self.settings.records_key:
+            extracted = _lookup(payload, self.settings.records_key)
+            if isinstance(extracted, list):
+                return extracted
+        if isinstance(payload, list):
+            return payload
+        if isinstance(payload, dict):
+            for key in ("records", "items", "data"):
+                value = payload.get(key)
+                if isinstance(value, list):
+                    return value
+        return [payload]
+
+    def _record(self, item: Any, index: int) -> IngestRecord:
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            name = str(
+                item.get("name")
+                or item.get("title")
+                or item.get("id")
+                or f"{self.name}-{index + 1}"
+            )
+            content = None
+            for key in ("content", "text", "description", "body", "summary"):
+                if isinstance(item.get(key), str):
+                    content = item[key]
+                    break
+            if content is None:
+                content = json.dumps(item, indent=2, default=str)
+            raw = item
+        elif isinstance(item, str):
+            name = f"{self.name}-{index + 1}"
+            content = item
+            raw = {"value": item}
+        else:
+            name = f"{self.name}-{index + 1}"
+            content = json.dumps(item, default=str)
+            raw = {"value": item}
+        return IngestRecord(
+            source_name=self.name,
+            source_kind=self.kind,
+            item_type=self.settings.item_type,
+            name=name,
+            content=content,
+            raw=raw,
+        )
+
+    async def health(self) -> HealthStatus:
+        try:
+            status, _ = self._request()
+        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+            return HealthStatus(ok=False, message=str(exc))
+        ok = 200 <= status < 400
+        return HealthStatus(
+            ok=ok,
+            message="reachable" if ok else f"HTTP {status}",
+            details={"status": status, "url": self.settings.url},
+        )
+
+    async def ingest(self) -> IngestBatch:
+        batch = IngestBatch(connector_name=self.name)
+        try:
+            status, body = self._request()
+        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+            batch.errors.append(str(exc))
+            return batch
+        if not 200 <= status < 400:
+            batch.errors.append(f"HTTP {status} from {self.settings.url}")
+            return batch
+        text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            payload: Any = json.loads(text)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            payload = text
+        records = self._items(payload)
+        for index, item in enumerate(records):
+            batch.records.append(self._record(item, index))
+        return batch
+
+
+class WebhookConnector(RestConnector):
+    """Posts to a webhook endpoint and ingests the JSON response."""
+
+    kind = "webhook"

+"""In-memory ingest sink owned by the connectors package."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from agentic_odi_connectors.models import IngestBatch, IngestRecord
+
+
+class IngestSink:
+    """Stores ingested batches for the current process."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._batches: list[IngestBatch] = []
+
+    def append(self, batch: IngestBatch) -> None:
+        self._batches.append(batch)
+
+    def batches(self) -> list[IngestBatch]:
+        return list(self._batches)
+
+    def records(self) -> list[IngestRecord]:
+        return [record for batch in self._batches for record in batch.records]
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        self._batches.clear()
+
+
+_default_sink = IngestSink()
+
+
+def get_default_sink() -> IngestSink:
+    return _default_sink

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+from agentic_odi_connectors.models import RestConnectorSettings
+from agentic_odi_connectors.rest.connector import RestConnector, WebhookConnector
+
+Calls = list[tuple[str, str, dict[str, str], bytes | None, float]]
+
+
+def _fetcher(status: int, payload: Any, calls: Calls | None = None):
+    def fetch(
+        method: str, url: str, headers: dict[str, str], body: bytes | None, timeout: float
+    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
+        if calls is not None:
+            calls.append((method, url, headers, body, timeout))
+        text = payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload)
+        return status, text.encode("utf-8")
+
+    return fetch
+
+
+def _connector(payload: Any, status: int = 200, **settings: Any) -> RestConnector:
+    base: dict[str, Any] = {"url": "https://api.example/records"}
+    base.update(settings)
+    return RestConnector(
+        name="jira",
+        settings=RestConnectorSettings(**base),
+        fetcher=_fetcher(status, payload),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_health_reports_reachable_on_2xx() -> None:
+    status = await _connector([]).health()
+
+    assert status.ok is True
+    assert status.message == "reachable"
+    assert status.details["status"] == 200
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_health_reports_http_failure() -> None:
+    status = await _connector([], status=503).health()
+
+    assert status.ok is False
+    assert "503" in status.message
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_ingest_normalizes_list_payload() -> None:
+    batch = await _connector([{"name": "ticket-1", "content": "Login fails"}]).ingest()
+
+    assert batch.errors == []
+    assert len(batch.records) == 1
+    record = batch.records[0]
+    assert record.name == "ticket-1"
+    assert record.content == "Login fails"
+    assert record.source_name == "jira"
+    assert record.source_kind == "rest"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_ingest_uses_records_key_and_serializes_objects() -> None:
+    payload = {"result": {"issues": [{"id": "ABC-1", "summary": "Slow deploy"}]}}
+    batch = await _connector(payload, records_key="result.issues").ingest()
+
+    assert len(batch.records) == 1
+    assert batch.records[0].name == "ABC-1"
+    assert batch.records[0].content == "Slow deploy"
+    assert batch.records[0].raw["id"] == "ABC-1"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_ingest_treats_plain_text_as_one_record() -> None:
+    batch = await _connector("customer says onboarding is slow").ingest()
+
+    assert len(batch.records) == 1
+    assert batch.records[0].content == "customer says onboarding is slow"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_ingest_records_fetch_errors() -> None:
+    def fetch(*_args: Any) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
+        raise ConnectionError("refused")
+
+    connector = RestConnector(
+        name="jira",
+        settings=RestConnectorSettings(url="https://api.example/records"),
+        fetcher=fetch,
+    )
+
+    batch = await connector.ingest()
+
+    assert batch.records == []
+    assert "refused" in batch.errors[0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_webhook_posts_json_body_and_uses_configured_item_type() -> None:
+    calls: Calls = []
+    connector = WebhookConnector(
+        name="inbox",
+        settings=RestConnectorSettings(
+            url="https://hooks.example/inbox",
+            method="POST",
+            json_body={"query": "latest"},
+            item_type="tool_result",
+        ),
+        fetcher=_fetcher(200, {"records": [{"name": "quote", "content": "Too slow"}]}, calls),
+    )
+
+    batch = await connector.ingest()
+
+    method, url, headers, body, _timeout = calls[0]
+    assert (method, url) == ("POST", "https://hooks.example/inbox")
+    assert headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"
+    assert body is not None and json.loads(body) == {"query": "latest"}
+    assert batch.records[0].source_kind == "webhook"
+    assert batch.records[0].item_type == "tool_result"

+from agentic_odi_connectors.models import IngestBatch, IngestRecord

+def test_append_stores_batch() -> None:
+    sink = IngestSink()
+    batch = IngestBatch(connector_name="gong")

+
+    assert sink.batches() == [batch]

+def test_records_flatten_batches() -> None:
+    sink = IngestSink()
+    first = IngestRecord(
+        source_name="gong",
+        source_kind="mcp",
+        item_type="catalog",
+        name="mcp-catalog",
+        content="{}",
+    )
+    second = IngestRecord(
+        source_name="gong",
+        source_kind="mcp",
+        item_type="resource",
+        name="feedback",
+        content="quote",

+
+    stored = sink.records()[0]
+

+    assert stored.source_kind == "mcp"
+    assert stored.name == "search"

+    " before ",
+    " after ",
+    " during ",
+    " if ",
+    " as ",
+)
+
+_VAGUE_TERMS = ("better", "improve", "optimize", "faster", "easier")
+
+
+def evaluate_outcome_statement(statement: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return format feedback for a desired-outcome statement."""
+    text = statement.strip()
+    lowered = text.lower()
+    padded = f" {lowered} "
+    issues: list[str] = []
+    suggestions: list[str] = []
+
+    direction: str | None = None
+    if lowered.startswith("minimize"):
+        direction = "minimize"
+    elif lowered.startswith("maximize"):
+        direction = "maximize"
+    else:
+        issues.append("Statement must start with 'Minimize' or 'Maximize'.")
+        suggestions.append("Start with 'Minimize/Maximize the [metric] ...'.")
+
+    if " the " not in padded:
+        issues.append("Name the object of control after 'the'.")
+        suggestions.append("Say what is being minimized or maximized, e.g. 'the time to ...'.")
+
+    if not any(marker in padded for marker in _CONTEXT_MARKERS):
+        issues.append("Add the execution context with 'when ...', 'while ...', or 'before ...'.")
+        suggestions.append("Close with the situation, e.g. '... when onboarding a new customer'.")
+
+    if len(text.split()) < 4:
+        issues.append("Statement is too short to describe a measurable outcome.")
+        suggestions.append("Describe the metric, the object, and the context.")
+
+    if len(text) > 200:
+        issues.append("Statement is longer than 200 characters; keep it to one measurable outcome.")
+        suggestions.append("Split broad statements into separate outcomes.")
+
+    vague = [term for term in _VAGUE_TERMS if term in lowered]
+    if vague:
+        issues.append(f"Replace vague terms with a measurable metric: {', '.join(vague)}.")
+        suggestions.append("Use a metric such as time, cost, effort, errors, or likelihood.")
+
+    return {
+        "statement": text,
+        "valid": not issues,
+        "direction": direction,
+        "issues": issues,
+        "suggestions": suggestions,
+    }

+"""Event-store contract shared by local SQLite and cloud adapters."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Protocol, TypedDict
+
+DEFAULT_WORKSPACE = "local"
+DEFAULT_DEVICE = "local"
+
+
+class Event(TypedDict):
+    """A single append-only domain event."""
+
+    id: int
+    event_id: str
+    workspace_id: str
+    device_id: str
+    timestamp: str
+    type: str
+    payload: dict[str, Any]
+    server_seq: int | None
+
+
+class EventStore(Protocol):
+    """Persistence boundary for the append-only event log."""
+
+    def append(
+        self,
+        event_type: str,
+        payload: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        event_id: str | None = None,
+        workspace_id: str = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE,
+        device_id: str = DEFAULT_DEVICE,
+    ) -> Event: ...
+
+    def get_stream(
+        self,
+        *,
+        workspace_id: str | None = None,
+        after_server_seq: int = 0,
+        unsynced_only: bool = False,
+        replay_order: bool = False,
+    ) -> list[Event]: ...
+
+    def insert_remote(self, events: list[Event]) -> int: ...
+
+    def mark_synced(self, server_seqs: dict[str, int]) -> int: ...
+
+    def retag_workspace(self, old: str, new: str) -> int: ...
+
+    def max_server_seq(self, workspace_id: str) -> int: ...
+
+    def get_cursor(self, workspace_id: str) -> int: ...
+
+    def set_cursor(self, workspace_id: str, remote_url: str, seq: int) -> None: ...
+
+    def pending_count(self, workspace_id: str) -> int: ...
+
+    def clear(self, *, workspace_id: str | None = None) -> None: ...
+
+    def close(self) -> None: ...
+
+
+def new_event_id() -> str:
+    """Return a globally unique, client-generated event identifier."""
+    return uuid.uuid4().hex
+
+
+def default_device_path() -> Path:
+    return Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.agentic-odi/device_id"))
+
+
+def resolve_device_id(path: Path | None = None) -> str:
+    """Return a stable random device id, creating it on first use.
+
+    The id is deliberately random: it must not reveal a hostname, user, or
+    anything else about the device.
+    """
+    configured = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DEVICE_ID")
+    if configured:
+        return configured
+
+    device_path = path or default_device_path()
+    try:
+        existing = device_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        existing = ""
+
+    if existing:
+        return existing
+
+    device_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    device_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    device_path.write_text(device_id + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return device_id

+"""Repository factory selecting a persistent or in-memory store."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import InMemoryRepository, Repository
+from agentic_odi_core.sqlite_repository import SQLiteRepository
+
+
+def build_repository(db_path: str | None = None) -> Repository:
+    resolved: str | None
+    if db_path is not None:
+        resolved = db_path
+    else:
+        resolved = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DB")
+    if resolved is None:
+        resolved = os.path.expanduser("~/.agentic-odi/odi.db")
+    if resolved == ":memory:":
+        return InMemoryRepository()
+    parent = os.path.dirname(resolved)
+    if parent:
+        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
+    return SQLiteRepository(db_path=resolved)

@@ -0,0 +1,279 @@
+"""Append-only event store backed by SQLite."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sqlite3
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_core.events import (
+    DEFAULT_DEVICE,
+    DEFAULT_WORKSPACE,
+    Event,
+    new_event_id,
+)
+
+_COLUMNS = {
+    "event_id": "TEXT",
+    "workspace_id": "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local'",
+    "device_id": "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local'",
+    "server_seq": "INTEGER",
+}
+
+
+class IntentStore:
+    """SQLite implementation of the append-only event contract."""
+
+    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "intent_store.db", check_same_thread: bool = True) -> None:
+        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, check_same_thread=check_same_thread)
+        self.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
+        self._init_db()
+
+    def _init_db(self) -> None:
+        with self.conn:
+            self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
+                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+                    event_id TEXT,
+                    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local',
+                    device_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local',
+                    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
+                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
+                    server_seq INTEGER
+                )
+                """
+            )
+            self._migrate_events_table()
+            self.conn.execute(
+                "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_event_id ON events(event_id)"
+            )
+            self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_workspace_server
+                ON events(workspace_id, server_seq)
+                """
+            )
+            self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_state (
+                    workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+                    remote_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+                    last_server_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
+                )
+                """
+            )
+
+    def _migrate_events_table(self) -> None:
+        existing = {row[1] for row in self.conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(events)").fetchall()}
+        for column, definition in _COLUMNS.items():
+            if column not in existing:
+                self.conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}")
+
+        missing_ids = [
+            row[0]
+            for row in self.conn.execute(
+                "SELECT id FROM events WHERE event_id IS NULL OR event_id = ''"
+            ).fetchall()
+        ]
+        for row_id in missing_ids:
+            self.conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE events SET event_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
+                (new_event_id(), row_id),
+            )
+
+    def append(
+        self,
+        event_type: str,
+        payload: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        event_id: str | None = None,
+        workspace_id: str = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE,
+        device_id: str = DEFAULT_DEVICE,
+    ) -> Event:
+        resolved_id = event_id or new_event_id()
+        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+        payload_json = json.dumps(payload)
+        with self.conn:
+            self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO events
+                    (event_id, workspace_id, device_id, timestamp, event_type, payload)
+                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                """,
+                (resolved_id, workspace_id, device_id, timestamp, event_type, payload_json),
+            )
+            row = self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                SELECT id, event_id, workspace_id, device_id, timestamp,
+                       event_type, payload, server_seq
+                FROM events WHERE event_id = ?
+                """,
+                (resolved_id,),
+            ).fetchone()
+
+        if row is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"event {resolved_id} could not be stored")
+        if row[2] != workspace_id:
+            raise ValueError(f"event_id {resolved_id} already belongs to another workspace")
+        return self._to_event(row)
+
+    def get_stream(
+        self,
+        *,
+        workspace_id: str | None = None,
+        after_server_seq: int = 0,
+        unsynced_only: bool = False,
+        replay_order: bool = False,
+    ) -> list[Event]:
+        clauses: list[str] = []
+        params: list[Any] = []
+        if workspace_id is not None:
+            clauses.append("workspace_id = ?")
+            params.append(workspace_id)
+        if after_server_seq:
+            clauses.append("server_seq IS NOT NULL AND server_seq > ?")
+            params.append(after_server_seq)
+        if unsynced_only:
+            clauses.append("server_seq IS NULL")
+
+        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
+        if replay_order:
+            order = "ORDER BY (server_seq IS NULL) ASC, server_seq ASC, id ASC"
+        else:
+            order = "ORDER BY id ASC"
+
+        cursor = self.conn.cursor()
+        # `where` and `order` are assembled from the literal fragments above, so
+        # interpolating them cannot inject SQL; every caller value is bound.
+        sql = (
+            "SELECT id, event_id, workspace_id, device_id, timestamp, "
+            "event_type, payload, server_seq FROM events "
+            f"{where} {order}"  # nosec B608 - static fragments, bound values
+        )
+        cursor.execute(sql, params)
+        return [self._to_event(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _to_event(row: tuple[Any, ...]) -> Event:
+        return Event(
+            id=row[0],
+            event_id=row[1],
+            workspace_id=row[2],
+            device_id=row[3],
+            timestamp=row[4],
+            type=row[5],
+            payload=json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else {},
+            server_seq=row[7],
+        )
+
+    def insert_remote(self, events: list[Event]) -> int:
+        inserted = 0
+        with self.conn:
+            for event in events:
+                self.conn.execute(
+                    """
+                    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO events
+                        (event_id, workspace_id, device_id, timestamp,
+                         event_type, payload, server_seq)
+                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                    """,
+                    (
+                        event["event_id"],
+                        event["workspace_id"],
+                        event["device_id"],
+                        event["timestamp"],
+                        event["type"],
+                        json.dumps(event["payload"]),
+                        event.get("server_seq"),
+                    ),
+                )
+                self.conn.execute(
+                    """
+                    UPDATE events SET server_seq = ?
+                    WHERE event_id = ? AND server_seq IS NULL AND workspace_id = ?
+                    """,
+                    (
+                        event.get("server_seq"),
+                        event["event_id"],
+                        event["workspace_id"],
+                    ),
+                )
+                inserted += 1
+        return inserted
+
+    def mark_synced(self, server_seqs: dict[str, int]) -> int:
+        updated = 0
+        with self.conn:
+            for event_id, server_seq in server_seqs.items():
+                cursor = self.conn.execute(
+                    "UPDATE events SET server_seq = ? WHERE event_id = ? AND server_seq IS NULL",
+                    (server_seq, event_id),
+                )
+                updated += cursor.rowcount
+        return updated
+
+    def retag_workspace(self, old: str, new: str) -> int:
+        updated = 0
+        with self.conn:
+            cursor = self.conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE events SET workspace_id = ? WHERE workspace_id = ?",
+                (new, old),
+            )
+            updated = cursor.rowcount
+            self.conn.execute(
+                "DELETE FROM sync_state WHERE workspace_id = ?",
+                (old,),
+            )
+        return updated
+
+    def max_server_seq(self, workspace_id: str) -> int:
+        row = self.conn.execute(
+            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(server_seq), 0) FROM events WHERE workspace_id = ?",
+            (workspace_id,),
+        ).fetchone()
+        return int(row[0]) if row else 0
+
+    def get_cursor(self, workspace_id: str) -> int:
+        row = self.conn.execute(
+            "SELECT last_server_seq FROM sync_state WHERE workspace_id = ?",
+            (workspace_id,),
+        ).fetchone()
+        return int(row[0]) if row else 0
+
+    def set_cursor(self, workspace_id: str, remote_url: str, seq: int) -> None:
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+        with self.conn:
+            self.conn.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT INTO sync_state (workspace_id, remote_url, last_server_seq, updated_at)
+                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
+                ON CONFLICT(workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET
+                    remote_url = excluded.remote_url,
+                    last_server_seq = excluded.last_server_seq,
+                    updated_at = excluded.updated_at
+                """,
+                (workspace_id, remote_url, seq, now),
+            )
+
+    def pending_count(self, workspace_id: str) -> int:
+        row = self.conn.execute(
+            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE workspace_id = ? AND server_seq IS NULL",
+            (workspace_id,),
+        ).fetchone()
+        return int(row[0]) if row else 0
+
+    def clear(self, *, workspace_id: str | None = None) -> None:
+        with self.conn:
+            if workspace_id is None:
+                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM events")
+                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM sync_state")
+            else:
+                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE workspace_id = ?", (workspace_id,))
+                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM sync_state WHERE workspace_id = ?", (workspace_id,))
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.conn.close()

+- **Outcome statement format**: 'Minimize/Maximize the [metric] when [context].'
+- **Tools to use**:
+  - `add_outcome(job_id, statement, importance, satisfaction)` — Capture each desired outcome with scores.
+  - `get_outcomes(job_id)` — Review all outcomes captured for a Job.
+  - `evaluate_outcome(statement, job_id?)` — Check that a statement starts with Minimize/Maximize, names a metric, and states its context before saving it.
+
+### Stage 3: Calculate Opportunity Scores
+- **When**: After outcomes have importance and satisfaction scores.
+- **Formula**: Opportunity Score = importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0)
+- **Scores > 10** indicate high innovation opportunity. Guide the user to focus efforts there.
+- **Tools to use**: `get_outcomes(job_id)` — Review opportunity_score field on each outcome.
+
+### Stage 4: Build the Job Map

+
+### General Rule

+"""Core domain models for Agentic ODI."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, computed_field
+
+
+class Direction(str, Enum):
+    MINIMIZE = "minimize"
+    MAXIMIZE = "maximize"
+
+
+class BusinessImpactCategory(str, Enum):
+    REVENUE_GROWTH = "revenue_growth"
+    COST_REDUCTION = "cost_reduction"
+    RETENTION = "retention"
+    RISK_MITIGATION = "risk_mitigation"
+    OPERATIONAL_EFFICIENCY = "operational_efficiency"
+    COMPLIANCE = "compliance"
+    BRAND_REPUTATION = "brand_reputation"
+    OTHER = "other"
+
+
+def compute_opportunity_score(importance: float, satisfaction: float) -> float:
+    """ODI Opportunity Score = importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0)."""
+    return float(importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0.0))
+
+
+class Job(BaseModel):
+    id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    name: str = Field(..., description="The name of the Job-to-be-Done")
+    description: str | None = Field(None, description="Detailed description of the Job")
+
+
+class Step(BaseModel):
+    id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    job_id: str = Field(..., description="The ID of the Job this step belongs to")
+    name: str = Field(..., description="The name of the job step")
+    order: int = Field(..., description="The chronological order of this step in the job map")
+
+
+class Outcome(BaseModel):
+    id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    job_id: str = Field(..., description="The ID of the Job this outcome relates to")
+    step_id: str | None = Field(None, description="The ID of the specific Step, if applicable")
+    statement: str = Field(
+        ..., description="The desired outcome statement (e.g., 'Minimize the time it takes to...')"
+    )
+    importance: float | None = Field(None, ge=1.0, le=10.0, description="Importance score (1-10)")
+    satisfaction: float | None = Field(
+        None, ge=1.0, le=10.0, description="Current satisfaction score (1-10)"
+    )
+    opportunity_score: float | None = Field(
+        None, description="Opportunity score (Importance + max(Importance - Satisfaction, 0))"
+    )
+
+
+class ValueMetric(BaseModel):
+    name: str
+    direction: Direction
+    unit_of_measure: str
+    importance: float = Field(ge=1.0, le=10.0)
+    satisfaction: float = Field(ge=1.0, le=10.0)
+
+    @computed_field
+    @property
+    def opportunity_score(self) -> float:
+        return compute_opportunity_score(self.importance, self.satisfaction)
+
+
+class CustomerValue(BaseModel):
+    direction: Direction
+    unit_of_measure: str
+    object_of_control: str
+    contextual_clarifier: str | None = None
+    statement: str
+    importance: float = Field(ge=1.0, le=10.0)
+    satisfaction: float = Field(ge=1.0, le=10.0)
+    value_metrics: list[ValueMetric] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+    @computed_field
+    @property
+    def opportunity_score(self) -> float:
+        return compute_opportunity_score(self.importance, self.satisfaction)
+
+
+class BusinessValue(BaseModel):
+    category: BusinessImpactCategory
+    statement: str
+    detail: str | None = None
+    estimated_annual_value: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0)
+    confidence: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+
+
+EvidenceItemType = Literal["catalog", "resource", "tool_result", "manual", "note"]
+
+
+class Evidence(BaseModel):
+    """A captured research record linked (optionally) to ODI artifacts."""
+
+    id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    source_name: str = Field(..., description="Connector or person that produced the record")
+    source_kind: str = Field(..., description="Connector kind, e.g. mcp, rest, webhook, manual")
+    item_type: EvidenceItemType = Field(
+        "manual", description="Normalized record kind produced by the connector"
+    )
+    name: str = Field(..., description="Short human-readable label for the record")
+    content: str = Field(..., description="Normalized text content of the record")
+    raw: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Original record payload")
+    job_id: str | None = Field(None, description="Job this evidence supports")
+    step_id: str | None = Field(None, description="Job-map Step this evidence supports")
+    outcome_id: str | None = Field(None, description="Desired Outcome this evidence supports")
+
+
+class CustomerOutcome(BaseModel):
+    id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    job_id: str = Field(..., description="The ID of the Job this outcome relates to")
+    step_id: str | None = Field(
+        default=None, description="The ID of the specific Step, if applicable"
+    )
+    customer_value: CustomerValue
+    business_value: BusinessValue
+
+    @computed_field
+    @property
+    def opportunity_score(self) -> float:
+        return self.customer_value.opportunity_score

+"""Repository interfaces and in-memory implementation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Protocol
+
+from agentic_odi_core.models import CustomerOutcome, Evidence, Job, Outcome, Step
+
+
+class Repository(Protocol):
+    jobs: dict[str, Job]
+    steps: dict[str, Step]
+    outcomes: dict[str, Outcome]
+    customer_outcomes: dict[str, CustomerOutcome]
+    evidence: dict[str, Evidence]
+
+    def add_job(self, job: Job) -> Job: ...
+    def list_jobs(self) -> list[Job]: ...
+    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None: ...
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict) -> Job | None: ...
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> bool: ...
+    def add_step(self, step: Step) -> Step: ...
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None: ...
+    def get_steps_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]: ...
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict) -> Step | None: ...
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> bool: ...
+    def add_outcome(self, outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome: ...
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None: ...
+    def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]: ...
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> Outcome | None: ...
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool: ...
+    def add_customer_outcome(self, co: CustomerOutcome) -> CustomerOutcome: ...
+    def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome | None: ...
+    def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]: ...
+    def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> CustomerOutcome | None: ...
+    def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool: ...
+    def add_evidence(self, evidence: Evidence) -> Evidence: ...
+    def get_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> Evidence | None: ...
+    def list_evidence(
+        self,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[Evidence]: ...
+    def delete_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> bool: ...
+    def clear(self) -> None: ...
+
+
+class InMemoryRepository:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
+        self.steps: dict[str, Step] = {}
+        self.outcomes: dict[str, Outcome] = {}
+        self.customer_outcomes: dict[str, CustomerOutcome] = {}
+        self.evidence: dict[str, Evidence] = {}
+
+    def add_job(self, job: Job) -> Job:
+        self.jobs[job.id] = job
+        return job
+
+    def list_jobs(self) -> list[Job]:
+        return list(self.jobs.values())
+
+    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None:
+        return self.jobs.get(job_id)
+
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict) -> Job | None:
+        job = self.jobs.get(job_id)
+        if not job:
+            return None
+        current = job.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_job = job.model_validate(current)
+        self.jobs[job_id] = new_job
+        return new_job
+
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
+        if job_id not in self.jobs:
+            return False
+        del self.jobs[job_id]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.steps.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.steps[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.outcomes[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+        for key in [
+            k
+            for k, v in self.evidence.items()
+            if v.job_id == job_id
+            or (v.step_id is not None and v.step_id not in self.steps)
+            or (v.outcome_id is not None and v.outcome_id not in self.outcomes)
+        ]:
+            del self.evidence[key]
+        return True
+
+    def add_step(self, step: Step) -> Step:
+        self.steps[step.id] = step
+        return step
+
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None:
+        return self.steps.get(step_id)
+
+    def get_steps_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]:
+        return [s for s in self.steps.values() if s.job_id == job_id]
+
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict) -> Step | None:
+        step = self.steps.get(step_id)
+        if not step:
+            return None
+        current = step.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_step = step.model_validate(current)
+        self.steps[step_id] = new_step
+        return new_step
+
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> bool:
+        if step_id not in self.steps:
+            return False
+        del self.steps[step_id]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+            del self.outcomes[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+            del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+        for key in [
+            k
+            for k, v in self.evidence.items()
+            if v.step_id == step_id
+            or (v.outcome_id is not None and v.outcome_id not in self.outcomes)
+        ]:
+            del self.evidence[key]
+        return True
+
+    def add_outcome(self, outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome:
+        self.outcomes[outcome.id] = outcome
+        return outcome
+
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None:
+        return self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+
+    def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]:
+        outs = [o for o in self.outcomes.values() if o.job_id == job_id]
+        if step_id is not None:
+            outs = [o for o in outs if o.step_id == step_id]
+        return outs
+
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> Outcome | None:
+        outcome = self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+        if not outcome:
+            return None
+        current = outcome.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_outcome = outcome.model_validate(current)
+        self.outcomes[outcome_id] = new_outcome
+        return new_outcome
+
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
+        if outcome_id in self.outcomes:
+            del self.outcomes[outcome_id]
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.evidence.items() if v.outcome_id == outcome_id]:
+                del self.evidence[key]
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def add_customer_outcome(self, co: CustomerOutcome) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        self.customer_outcomes[co.id] = co
+        return co
+
+    def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
+        return self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+
+    def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]:
+        if job_id is None:
+            return list(self.customer_outcomes.values())
+        return [co for co in self.customer_outcomes.values() if co.job_id == job_id]
+
+    def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
+        co = self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+        if not co:
+            return None
+        current = co.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_co = co.model_validate(current)
+        self.customer_outcomes[outcome_id] = new_co
+        return new_co
+
+    def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
+        if outcome_id in self.customer_outcomes:
+            del self.customer_outcomes[outcome_id]
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def add_evidence(self, evidence: Evidence) -> Evidence:
+        self.evidence[evidence.id] = evidence
+        return evidence
+
+    def get_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> Evidence | None:
+        return self.evidence.get(evidence_id)
+
+    def list_evidence(
+        self,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[Evidence]:
+        items = list(self.evidence.values())
+        if job_id is not None:
+            items = [item for item in items if item.job_id == job_id]
+        if step_id is not None:
+            items = [item for item in items if item.step_id == step_id]
+        if outcome_id is not None:
+            items = [item for item in items if item.outcome_id == outcome_id]
+        return items
+
+    def delete_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> bool:
+        if evidence_id in self.evidence:
+            del self.evidence[evidence_id]
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        self.jobs.clear()
+        self.steps.clear()
+        self.outcomes.clear()
+        self.customer_outcomes.clear()
+        self.evidence.clear()

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+"""Canonical JSON schemas for every ODI entity.
+
+These schemas are the machine-readable contract used by agents, connectors, and
+CLI consumers. They are derived from the Pydantic models so there is exactly one
+definition of the ODI dataset.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from agentic_odi_core.models import (
+    BusinessValue,
+    CustomerOutcome,
+    CustomerValue,
+    Evidence,
+    Job,
+    Outcome,
+    Step,
+    ValueMetric,
+)
+
+_SCHEMA_MODELS: dict[str, type[BaseModel]] = {
+    "Job": Job,
+    "Step": Step,
+    "Outcome": Outcome,
+    "ValueMetric": ValueMetric,
+    "CustomerValue": CustomerValue,
+    "BusinessValue": BusinessValue,
+    "CustomerOutcome": CustomerOutcome,
+    "Evidence": Evidence,
+}
+
+
+def odi_schema() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return the JSON schema for each ODI entity keyed by model name."""
+    return {name: model.model_json_schema() for name, model in _SCHEMA_MODELS.items()}

@@ -0,0 +1,323 @@
+"""Service layer implementing business logic."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_core.models import (
+    BusinessValue,
+    CustomerOutcome,
+    CustomerValue,
+    Evidence,
+    EvidenceItemType,
+    Job,
+    Outcome,
+    Step,
+    compute_opportunity_score,
+)
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import Repository
+
+
+class JobNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, job_id: str) -> None:
+        self.job_id = job_id
+        super().__init__(job_id)
+
+
+class StepNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, step_id: str) -> None:
+        self.step_id = step_id
+        super().__init__(step_id)
+
+
+class OutcomeNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        self.outcome_id = outcome_id
+        super().__init__(outcome_id)
+
+
+class CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        self.outcome_id = outcome_id
+        super().__init__(outcome_id)
+
+
+class EvidenceNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        self.evidence_id = evidence_id
+        super().__init__(evidence_id)
+
+
+class ValueOutOfRangeError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _first_line(text: str) -> str:
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if stripped:
+            return stripped
+    return ""
+
+
+class ODIService:
+    def __init__(self, repo: Repository) -> None:
+        self.repo = repo
+
+    def add_job(self, name: str, description: str | None = None) -> Job:
+        job = Job(name=name, description=description)
+        return self.repo.add_job(job)
+
+    def get_jobs(self) -> list[Job]:
+        return self.repo.list_jobs()
+
+    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None:
+        return self.repo.get_job(job_id)
+
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None:
+        return self.repo.get_step(step_id)
+
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None:
+        return self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Job:
+        res = self.repo.update_job(job_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_job(job_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Step:
+        res = self.repo.update_step(step_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_step(step_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Outcome:
+        existing = self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if existing is None:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        importance = updates.get("importance", existing.importance)
+        satisfaction = updates.get("satisfaction", existing.satisfaction)
+        if importance is not None and not (1.0 <= importance <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if satisfaction is not None and not (1.0 <= satisfaction <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if importance is not None and satisfaction is not None:
+            updates = dict(updates)
+            updates["opportunity_score"] = compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)
+        else:
+            updates = dict(updates)
+            updates["opportunity_score"] = None
+        res = self.repo.update_outcome(outcome_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+
+    def add_step(self, job_id: str, name: str, order: int) -> Step:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        step = Step(id=str(uuid.uuid4()), job_id=job_id, name=name, order=order)
+        return self.repo.add_step(step)
+
+    def get_job_map(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]:
+        steps = self.repo.get_steps_for_job(job_id)
+        return sorted(steps, key=lambda s: s.order)
+
+    def add_outcome(
+        self,
+        job_id: str,
+        statement: str,
+        importance: float | None = None,
+        satisfaction: float | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> Outcome:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        if step_id is not None and self.repo.get_step(step_id) is None:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        if importance is not None and not (1.0 <= importance <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if satisfaction is not None and not (1.0 <= satisfaction <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        opportunity_score = None
+        if importance is not None and satisfaction is not None:
+            opportunity_score = compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)
+        outcome = Outcome(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            job_id=job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            statement=statement,
+            importance=importance,
+            satisfaction=satisfaction,
+            opportunity_score=opportunity_score,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_outcome(outcome)
+
+    def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]:
+        return self.repo.get_outcomes(job_id, step_id)
+
+    def add_customer_outcome(
+        self,
+        job_id: str,
+        customer_value: CustomerValue | dict[str, Any],
+        business_value: BusinessValue | dict[str, Any],
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        if step_id is not None and self.repo.get_step(step_id) is None:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        if isinstance(customer_value, dict):
+            cv = CustomerValue.model_validate(customer_value)
+        else:
+            cv = customer_value
+        if isinstance(business_value, dict):
+            bv = BusinessValue.model_validate(business_value)
+        else:
+            bv = business_value
+        co = CustomerOutcome(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            job_id=job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            customer_value=cv,
+            business_value=bv,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_customer_outcome(co)
+
+    def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        co = self.repo.get_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not co:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return co
+
+    def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]:
+        return self.repo.list_customer_outcomes(job_id)
+
+    def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        res = self.repo.update_customer_outcome(outcome_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+
+    def add_evidence(
+        self,
+        source_name: str,
+        source_kind: str,
+        name: str,
+        content: str,
+        item_type: EvidenceItemType = "manual",
+        raw: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> Evidence:
+        resolved_job_id = job_id
+        if step_id is not None:
+            step = self.repo.get_step(step_id)
+            if step is None:
+                raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+            if resolved_job_id is None:
+                resolved_job_id = step.job_id
+            elif step.job_id != resolved_job_id:
+                raise ValueError("step_id does not belong to job_id")
+        if outcome_id is not None:
+            outcome = self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+            if outcome is None:
+                raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+            if resolved_job_id is None:
+                resolved_job_id = outcome.job_id
+            elif outcome.job_id != resolved_job_id:
+                raise ValueError("outcome_id does not belong to job_id")
+            if step_id is not None and outcome.step_id not in (None, step_id):
+                raise ValueError("outcome_id does not belong to step_id")
+        if resolved_job_id is not None and self.repo.get_job(resolved_job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(resolved_job_id)
+        evidence = Evidence(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            source_name=source_name,
+            source_kind=source_kind,
+            item_type=item_type,
+            name=name,
+            content=content,
+            raw=raw or {},
+            job_id=resolved_job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            outcome_id=outcome_id,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_evidence(evidence)
+
+    def get_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> Evidence | None:
+        return self.repo.get_evidence(evidence_id)
+
+    def list_evidence(
+        self,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[Evidence]:
+        return self.repo.list_evidence(job_id=job_id, step_id=step_id, outcome_id=outcome_id)
+
+    def delete_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        if not self.repo.delete_evidence(evidence_id):
+            raise EvidenceNotFoundError(evidence_id)
+
+    def promote_evidence(
+        self,
+        evidence_id: str,
+        target: str,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        statement: str | None = None,
+        name: str | None = None,
+        importance: float | None = None,
+        satisfaction: float | None = None,
+    ) -> Job | Outcome:
+        evidence = self.repo.get_evidence(evidence_id)
+        if evidence is None:
+            raise EvidenceNotFoundError(evidence_id)
+        if target == "job":
+            label = (
+                (name or evidence.name).strip() or _first_line(evidence.content) or "Imported job"
+            )
+            return self.add_job(label, description=evidence.content or None)
+        if target == "outcome":
+            target_job_id = job_id or evidence.job_id
+            if target_job_id is None:
+                raise ValueError("job_id is required to promote evidence to an outcome")
+            text = (
+                statement
+                or evidence.name.strip()
+                or _first_line(evidence.content)
+                or "Untitled outcome"
+            )
+            return self.add_outcome(
+                target_job_id,
+                text,
+                importance=importance,
+                satisfaction=satisfaction,
+                step_id=evidence.step_id,
+            )
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown promotion target: {target}")
+
+    def compute_opportunity(self, importance: float, satisfaction: float) -> float:
+        return compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)

+        device_id: str | None = None,

+            db_path = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DB", os.path.expanduser("~/.agentic-odi/odi.db"))
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(db_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)

+        self.store = IntentStore(db_path, check_same_thread=False)
+        self._last_event_id = 0
+        self._load_snapshot()
+
+    def _load_snapshot(self) -> None:
+        self.jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
+        self.steps: dict[str, Step] = {}
+        self.outcomes: dict[str, Outcome] = {}

+        self.evidence: dict[str, Evidence] = {}

+        elif et == "STEP_CREATED":
+            self.steps[p["id"]] = Step.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "OUTCOME_CREATED":
+            self.outcomes[p["id"]] = Outcome.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_CREATED":
+            self.customer_outcomes[p["id"]] = CustomerOutcome.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "EVIDENCE_CREATED":
+            self.evidence[p["id"]] = Evidence.model_validate(p)

+        elif et == "STEP_UPDATED":

+        elif et == "OUTCOME_UPDATED":

+        elif et == "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_UPDATED":
+            self._merge_updates(self.customer_outcomes, p, CustomerOutcome)

+"""Tests for the new event-store schema and migration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from agentic_odi_core.intent_store import IntentStore
+
+
+def test_legacy_db_backfill_adds_event_id_and_spaces(tmp_path) -> None:
+    """An existing `odi.db` without `event_id` columns must be upgraded."""
+    db = Path(tmp_path) / "odi.db"
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
+    conn.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE events (
+            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
+            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+            payload TEXT NOT NULL
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO events (timestamp, event_type, payload) VALUES ('2026-01-01T00:00:00', 'JOB_CREATED', '{\"id\": \"j1\"}')"
+    )
+    conn.commit()
+    conn.close()
+
+    store = IntentStore(str(db))
+    events = store.get_stream()
+    # The migration must have added event_id, workspace_id, device_id columns,
+    # backfilled them, and the row must contain them.
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    ev = events[0]
+    assert ev["event_id"]
+    assert ev["workspace_id"] == "local"
+    assert ev["device_id"] == "local"
+    assert ev["server_seq"] is None
+    store.close()
+
+
+def test_new_db_has_all_columns(tmp_path) -> None:
+    """A freshly created DB must contain all new event columns."""
+    db = Path(tmp_path) / "odi.db"
+    store = IntentStore(str(db))
+    events = store.get_stream()
+    assert len(events) == 0
+    # Verify schema contains all new columns via PRAGMA introspection.
+    # (the constructor runs _migrate_events_table and adds columns.)
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db))
+    cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(events)").fetchall()}
+    assert "event_id" in cols, f"Missing event_id column, got: {cols}"
+    assert "workspace_id" in cols
+    assert "device_id" in cols
+    assert "server_seq" in cols
+    conn.close()
+    store.close()

+    finally:

 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 #
 # Build a self-contained, onedir PyInstaller bundle of the `odi` CLI and
 # package it into a distributable archive at the repository root.
 #
 # Environment:
 #   VERSION            required, e.g. 0.1.0
 #   RELEASE_DATE_UTC   optional, e.g. 2026-10-15T21:13:00Z (default: "")
 #   COMMIT             optional (default: dev)
 #   TARGET             optional, e.g. linux_x86_64 (default: dev)
 #
 # The absolute path of the produced archive is printed on the last line.
 set -euo pipefail
 
 export UV_PYTHON="${UV_PYTHON:-3.11}"
 
 REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
 cd "$REPO_ROOT"
 
 VERSION="${VERSION:?VERSION is required}"
 RELEASE_DATE_UTC="${RELEASE_DATE_UTC:-}"
 COMMIT="${COMMIT:-dev}"
 TARGET="${TARGET:-dev}"
 
 # _build_info.py is tracked with committed dev defaults; the build regenerates
 # it from the environment. Back it up and always restore it on exit (even on
 # failure) so a build never leaves the working tree dirty.
-BUILD_INFO="cli/src/cli/_build_info.py"
+BUILD_INFO="apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/_build_info.py"
 BUILD_INFO_BACKUP="$(mktemp)"
 cp "$BUILD_INFO" "$BUILD_INFO_BACKUP"
 restore_build_info() {
     cp "$BUILD_INFO_BACKUP" "$BUILD_INFO"
     rm -f "$BUILD_INFO_BACKUP"
 }
 trap restore_build_info EXIT
 
 echo "==> Syncing workspace (uv)"
 uv sync --all-packages --locked

+"""
+Local dev launcher for Agentic ODI.
+
+Starts the FastMCP server (``python -m agentic_odi_mcp_server``) and the Living
+Studio sidecar (``uvicorn agentic_odi_studio_api.app:create_app --factory``)
+concurrently, then prints the MCP and Studio URLs. Shutting down this script
+(Ctrl+C) terminates both processes.
+
+Usage:
+    uv run python scripts/dev.py
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import signal
+import socket
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - launches only fixed child commands (see B603 notes)
+import sys
+import time
+
+MCP_PORT = 8000
+STUDIO_PORT = 8100
+
+REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+SPA_DIST = os.environ.get(
+    "AGENTIC_ODI_STUDIO_DIST", os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "apps", "studio", "dist")
+)
+SPA_BUILD_HINT = (
+    "Frontend not built — run `npm --prefix apps/studio run build` to serve the Studio UI."
+)
+
+
+def is_port_in_use(port: int) -> bool:
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
+        return s.connect_ex(("localhost", port)) == 0
+
+
+def build_commands() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return the (mcp_server, sidecar) argv lists, both shell-free and fixed."""
+    mcp_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "agentic_odi_mcp_server"]
+    sidecar_command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-m",
+        "uvicorn",
+        "agentic_odi_studio_api.app:create_app",
+        "--factory",
+        "--host",
+        "127.0.0.1",
+        "--port",
+        str(STUDIO_PORT),
+    ]
+    return mcp_command, sidecar_command
+
+
+def start_server() -> subprocess.Popen:
+    if is_port_in_use(MCP_PORT):
+        print(f"Error: Port {MCP_PORT} is already in use.")
+        print("Please stop any process running on this port and try again.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    mcp_command, _ = build_commands()
+    print(f"Starting MCP server on http://localhost:{MCP_PORT}/mcp ...")
+    # Fixed command, no shell, no untrusted input.
+    return subprocess.Popen(mcp_command)  # nosec B603
+
+
+def start_studio() -> subprocess.Popen:
+    if is_port_in_use(STUDIO_PORT):
+        print(f"Warning: Port {STUDIO_PORT} is already in use. The sidecar may fail to start.")
+
+    _, sidecar_command = build_commands()
+    print(f"Starting Living Studio sidecar on http://localhost:{STUDIO_PORT} ...")
+    # Fixed command, no shell, no untrusted input.
+    return subprocess.Popen(sidecar_command)  # nosec B603
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    server = None
+    studio = None
+
+    def shutdown(signum=None, frame=None):
+        print("\nShutting down...")
+        if studio:
+            studio.terminate()
+        if server:
+            server.terminate()
+
+        try:
+            if studio:
+                studio.wait(timeout=5)
+            if server:
+                server.wait(timeout=5)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            if studio:
+                studio.kill()
+            if server:
+                server.kill()
+
+        print("✅ All processes stopped.")
+        sys.exit(0)
+
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, shutdown)
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, shutdown)
+
+    try:
+        server = start_server()
+        # Give the server a moment to bind its port before the sidecar connects
+        time.sleep(2)
+        studio = start_studio()
+
+        print("\nBoth processes are running.")
+        print(f"MCP Server   -> http://localhost:{MCP_PORT}/mcp")
+        print(f"Living Studio -> http://localhost:{STUDIO_PORT}")
+        if not os.path.isdir(SPA_DIST):
+            print(f"\n⚠️  {SPA_BUILD_HINT}")
+        print("\nPress Ctrl+C to stop both.\n")
+
+        # Wait for either process to exit unexpectedly
+        while True:
+            rc_server = server.poll()
+            rc_studio = studio.poll()
+
+            if rc_server is not None:
+                print(f"\nServer exited unexpectedly (code {rc_server}).")
+                break
+
+            if rc_studio is not None:
+                print(f"\nStudio sidecar exited unexpectedly (code {rc_studio}).")
+                break
+
+            time.sleep(1)
+
+    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
+        print(f"\nError: {e}")
+    finally:
+        shutdown()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Generate and publish end-user "Download & Run" instructions for a GitHub release.
+
+Pure functions:
+    build_instructions_section(tag, repo, artifacts, checksums_text) -> str
+    apply_instructions(body, section) -> str
+
+CLI (``main``): fetches the release body/assets via ``gh``, grabs
+``checksums.txt`` via ``curl``, builds the instructions section, applies it
+idempotently to the release body, and publishes with ``gh release edit``
+(unless ``--dry-run``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DOWNLOAD_START = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->"
+DOWNLOAD_END = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->"
+
+GITHUB_RELEASES = "https://github.com"
+
+
+def _archive_target(name: str) -> str:
+    """Strip the ``odi_<version>_`` prefix and archive suffix to expose ``<os>_<arch>``."""
+    stem = name
+    for suffix in (".tar.gz", ".zip"):
+        if stem.endswith(suffix):
+            stem = stem[: -len(suffix)]
+            break
+    if stem.startswith("odi_"):
+        stem = stem[len("odi_") :]
+    parts = stem.split("_")
+    if len(parts) >= 3:
+        return "_".join(parts[1:])
+    return stem
+
+
+def _platform(target: str) -> str:
+    mapping = {
+        "linux_x86_64": "Linux (x86_64)",
+        "linux_arm64": "Linux (ARM64)",
+        "macos_x86_64": "macOS (Intel)",
+        "macos_arm64": "macOS (Apple Silicon)",
+        "windows_x86_64": "Windows (x86_64)",
+    }
+    return mapping.get(target, target.replace("_", " ").title())
+
+
+def _hash_for(checksums_text: str, name: str) -> str | None:
+    for line in checksums_text.splitlines():
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line:
+            continue
+        hash_, sep, fname = line.partition("  ")
+        if not sep:
+            hash_, sep, fname = line.partition(" ")
+        fname = fname.lstrip("*").strip()
+        if fname == name:
+            return hash_.strip()
+    return None
+
+
+def build_instructions_section(
+    tag: str, repo: str, artifacts: list[dict], checksums_text: str
+) -> str:
+    version = tag.lstrip("v")
+    dl_base = f"{GITHUB_RELEASES}/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}"
+
+    release_artifacts = [
+        a for a in artifacts if a["name"] not in ("checksums.txt", "install.sh", "install.ps1")
+    ]
+
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    lines.append("## 📦 Download & Run")
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append(
+        f"Prebuilt binaries for **Agentic ODI {version}** are attached to this release. "
+        "Pick the archive for your platform, verify its SHA-256 against ``checksums.txt``, "
+        "then install with the one-liner below."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+
+    if release_artifacts:
+        lines.append("| Platform | Archive | Download | SHA-256 |")
+        lines.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
+        for a in sorted(release_artifacts, key=lambda x: x["name"]):
+            name = a["name"]
+            target = _archive_target(name)
+            url = a["browser_download_url"]
+            digest = _hash_for(checksums_text, name) or "—"
+            lines.append(f"| {_platform(target)} | {name} | [download]({url}) | `{digest}` |")
+        lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Verify")
+    lines.append("Download ``checksums.txt`` from this release and verify the archive you picked:")
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append("curl -fsSL -O checksums.txt")
+    lines.append(f"{dl_base}/checksums.txt")
+    lines.append("sha256sum -c checksums.txt   # or: shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Install (one liner)")
+    lines.append("**Linux / macOS**")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append(f"curl -fsSL {dl_base}/install.sh | sh")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("**Windows (PowerShell)**")
+    lines.append("```powershell")
+    lines.append(f"iex (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri {dl_base}/install.ps1 -UseBasicParsing)")
+    lines.append("# shorthand: install.ps1 | iex")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Install manually")
+    lines.append(
+        "Extract the archive, then add the folder containing the ``odi`` executable to your ``PATH``."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append(f"tar -xzf odi_{version}_<platform>.tar.gz   # or unzip the .zip on Windows")
+    lines.append('export PATH="$PWD:$PATH"')
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Quick start")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append("odi --version")
+    lines.append("odi --help")
+    lines.append("odi jobs list")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Related artifacts")
+    for kind in ("checksums.txt", "install.sh", "install.ps1"):
+        match = next((a for a in artifacts if a["name"] == kind), None)
+        if match:
+            lines.append(f"- [{kind}]({match['browser_download_url']})")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append(
+        "> macOS may quarantine the downloaded binary "
+        "(``xattr -d com.apple.quarantine odi`` if needed). "
+        'Windows SmartScreen may warn for unsigned binaries; choose "More info → Run anyway" '
+        "if you trust the release."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+
+    return f"{DOWNLOAD_START}\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + DOWNLOAD_END + "\n"
+
+
+def apply_instructions(body: str | None, section: str) -> str:
+    current = body if body is not None else ""
+    start = current.find(DOWNLOAD_START)
+    end = current.find(DOWNLOAD_END)
+    if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
+        head = current[:start].rstrip()
+        tail = current[end + len(DOWNLOAD_END) :].lstrip("\n")
+        if head and tail:
+            return head + "\n\n" + section + "\n" + tail
+        if head:
+            return head + "\n\n" + section + "\n" + tail
+        return section + "\n" + tail
+    current = current.rstrip()
+    if not current:
+        return section
+    return current + "\n\n" + section
+
+
+def _run(cmd: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Publish end-user download & run instructions to a GitHub release."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--tag", required=True, help="Release tag, e.g. v0.7.0")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--repo",
+        default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", ""),
+        help="GitHub repository as owner/name",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dry-run",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Print the new body instead of publishing",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    tag = args.tag
+    repo = args.repo
+    if not repo:
+        print("error: --repo or GITHUB_REPOSITORY is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    view = _run(["gh", "release", "view", tag, "--repo", repo, "--json", "body"])
+    body = json.loads(view.stdout).get("body", "") or ""
+
+    assets: list[dict] = []
+    try:
+        api = _run(["gh", "api", f"repos/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}", "--json", "assets"])
+        assets = json.loads(api.stdout).get("assets", [])
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+        assets = []
+
+    checksums_text = ""
+    try:
+        ck = _run(
+            [
+                "curl",
+                "-fsSL",
+                f"{GITHUB_RELEASES}/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/checksums.txt",
+            ]
+        )
+        checksums_text = ck.stdout
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+        checksums_text = ""
+
+    section = build_instructions_section(tag, repo, assets, checksums_text)
+    new_body = apply_instructions(body, section)
+
+    if args.dry_run:
+        print(new_body)
+        return 0
+
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".md", delete=False) as fh:
+        fh.write(new_body)
+        notes_path = fh.name
+    try:
+        _run(["gh", "release", "edit", tag, "--repo", repo, "--notes-file", notes_path])
+    finally:
+        Path(notes_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Tests for the launcher lifecycle: start, poll, and shut down both services."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import signal
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts import dev as run
+
+
+class _FakeProcess:
+    def __init__(self, poll_results: list[int | None] | None = None, wait_error=None) -> None:
+        self._poll_results = list(poll_results) if poll_results is not None else []
+        self._wait_error = wait_error
+        self.terminated = False
+        self.killed = False
+
+    def poll(self) -> int | None:
+        return self._poll_results.pop(0) if self._poll_results else None
+
+    def terminate(self) -> None:
+        self.terminated = True
+
+    def wait(self, timeout=None) -> int:
+        if self._wait_error is not None:
+            raise self._wait_error
+        return 0
+
+    def kill(self) -> None:
+        self.killed = True
+
+
+def _quiet_main(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.time, "sleep", lambda seconds: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.signal, "signal", lambda signum, handler: None)
+
+
+def test_start_server_exits_when_the_port_is_busy(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: True)
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc_info:
+        run.start_server()
+
+    assert exc_info.value.code == 1
+    assert f"Port {run.MCP_PORT} is already in use" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_start_server_launches_the_fixed_module(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
+    launched: list[list[str]] = []
+
+    def _popen(argv: list[str]) -> _FakeProcess:
+        launched.append(argv)
+        return _FakeProcess()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.subprocess, "Popen", _popen)
+
+    process = run.start_server()
+
+    assert isinstance(process, _FakeProcess)
+    assert launched == [[run.sys.executable, "-m", "agentic_odi_mcp_server"]]
+    assert "Starting MCP server" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_start_studio_warns_but_still_launches(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
+    launched: list[list[str]] = []
+
+    def _popen(argv: list[str]) -> _FakeProcess:
+        launched.append(argv)
+        return _FakeProcess()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.subprocess, "Popen", _popen)
+
+    run.start_studio()
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert f"Port {run.STUDIO_PORT} is already in use" in output
+    assert launched == [run.build_commands()[1]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("exiting", ["server", "studio"])
+def test_main_reports_an_unexpected_exit_and_stops_both(monkeypatch, capsys, exiting) -> None:
+    _quiet_main(monkeypatch)
+    server = _FakeProcess([0] if exiting == "server" else [None])
+    studio = _FakeProcess([0] if exiting == "studio" else [None])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_server", lambda: server)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_studio", lambda: studio)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "SPA_DIST", Path("/nonexistent/studio/dist"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc_info:
+        run.main()
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    expected = (
+        "Server exited unexpectedly"
+        if exiting == "server"
+        else "Studio sidecar exited unexpectedly"
+    )
+    assert exc_info.value.code == 0
+    assert expected in output
+    assert "All processes stopped." in output
+    assert "Frontend not built" in output
+    assert server.terminated is True
+    assert studio.terminated is True
+
+
+def test_main_waits_while_both_processes_are_running(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    sleeps: list[float] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.time, "sleep", sleeps.append)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.signal, "signal", lambda signum, handler: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_server", lambda: _FakeProcess([None, 0]))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_studio", lambda: _FakeProcess([None, None]))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "SPA_DIST", Path("/nonexistent/studio/dist"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        run.main()
+
+    assert sleeps == [2, 1]
+
+
+def test_main_kills_processes_that_ignore_termination(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
+    _quiet_main(monkeypatch)
+    timeout = subprocess.TimeoutExpired(cmd="odi", timeout=5)
+    server = _FakeProcess([0], wait_error=timeout)
+    studio = _FakeProcess([None], wait_error=timeout)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_server", lambda: server)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_studio", lambda: studio)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "SPA_DIST", Path("/nonexistent/studio/dist"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        run.main()
+
+    assert server.killed is True
+    assert studio.killed is True
+
+
+def test_main_reports_startup_errors(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
+    _quiet_main(monkeypatch)
+
+    def _boom() -> None:
+        raise RuntimeError("boom")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_server", _boom)
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        run.main()
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "Error: boom" in output
+    assert "All processes stopped." in output
+
+
+def test_main_installs_signal_handlers(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    seen: list[int] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "is_port_in_use", lambda port: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.time, "sleep", lambda seconds: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run.signal, "signal", lambda signum, handler: seen.append(signum))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_server", lambda: _FakeProcess([0]))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "start_studio", lambda: _FakeProcess([None]))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(run, "SPA_DIST", Path("/nonexistent/studio/dist"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        run.main()
+
+    assert seen == [signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM]
